INSERT INTO `meeting` ( `id`, `meeting_code`, `meeting_type`, `meeting_type_name`, `meeting_reason`, `meeting_start_time`, `meeting_end_time`, `meeting_process_audio`, `third_record_id`, `deleted`, `tenant`, `create_by`, `creator_id`, `creator_type`, `create_time`, `update_by`, `updater_id`, `updater_type`, `update_time` ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.meetingCode}, #{item.meetingType}, #{item.meetingTypeName}, #{item.meetingReason}, #{item.meetingStartTime}, #{item.meetingEndTime}, #{item.meetingProcessAudio}, #{item.thirdRecordId}, #{item.deleted}, #{item.tenant}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.creatorId}, #{item.creatorType}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updaterId}, #{item.updaterType}, #{item.updateTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `meeting_code` = VALUES(`meeting_code`), `meeting_type` = VALUES(`meeting_type`), `meeting_type_name` = VALUES(`meeting_type_name`), `meeting_reason` = VALUES(`meeting_reason`), `meeting_start_time` = VALUES(`meeting_start_time`), `meeting_end_time` = VALUES(`meeting_end_time`), `meeting_process_audio` = VALUES(`meeting_process_audio`), `deleted` = VALUES(`deleted`), `update_by` = VALUES(`update_by`), `updater_id` = VALUES(`updater_id`), `updater_type` = VALUES(`updater_type`), `update_time` = VALUES(`update_time`)
mapper.select:
SELECT m.`id`, m.`meeting_code`, m.`meeting_type`, m.`meeting_type_name`, m.`meeting_reason`, m.`meeting_start_time`, m.`meeting_end_time`, m.`meeting_process_audio`, m.`third_record_id`, m.`deleted`, m.`tenant`, m.`create_by`, m.`create_time`, m.`update_by`, m.`update_time` FROM `meeting` m LEFT JOIN `meeting_apply_person` mapp ON m.`id` = mapp.`business_key`
m.`deleted` = 0
AND m.`meeting_start_time` >= #{param.meetingPeriod.begin} AND m.`meeting_end_time` <= #{param.meetingPeriod.end}
AND mapp.`meeting_person_name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.visitedPerson}, '%') AND mapp.`meeting_person_type` = 2
group by m.`id` ORDER BY m.`create_time` DESC

SELECT m.`id`, m.`meeting_code`, m.`meeting_type`, m.`meeting_type_name`, m.`meeting_reason`, m.`meeting_start_time`, m.`meeting_end_time`, m.`meeting_process_audio`, m.`third_record_id`, m.`deleted`, m.`tenant`, m.`create_by`, m.`create_time`, m.`update_by`, m.`update_time` FROM `meeting` m
m.`deleted` = 0
AND m.`meeting_start_time` >= #{param.period.begin} AND m.`meeting_start_time` <= #{param.period.end}
ORDER BY m.`create_time` DESC
